newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 15.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 15.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- At the Parliament, the opposition and government party MPs have rejected a proposed property tax law.
-- Deficit of the social insurance increased in March but the deficit of the state budget did not surpass predictions.
-- Transportation experts say Hungary should construct 2,000 kms of new bike lanes.
-- Hungary will discontinue visas for Japanese visitors, Foreign Ministry spokesman Gabor Szentivanyi said.
-- From May 14, there will be no visas between Mexico and Hungary, the foreign ministry announced.
